title: SELECTIVE INSURANCE GROUP INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-30
summary: Selective Insurance Group, Inc. filed this 8-K to disclose the voting results from its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on April 29, 2026. All twelve director nominees were elected, stockholders approved the advisory say-on-pay vote for 2025 executive compensation, and shareholders ratified the appointment of KPMG LLP as the company's independent auditor for fiscal year 2026.
key_points: All twelve director nominees were elected to the Board of Directors for one-year terms.
Stockholders approved the advisory vote on 2025 executive compensation (say-on-pay) with 47,882,612 votes for, 768,525 against, and 116,897 abstentions.
The appointment of KPMG LLP as independent auditor for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 was ratified with 52,567,600 votes for and 842,875 against.
This 8-K was signed by Michael H. Lanza, Executive Vice President and General Counsel, on April 30, 2026.
